1. CAJ MARIN

 Caj marin hendaklah seperti yang berikut:

(a) Caj Marin yang Disatukan

Caj marin adalah disatukan untuk menjadikan  dius pelabuhan,  dius
pemaliman, dius penundaan , caj tambatan dan caj limbungan sebagai
satu caj.

(i) Caj marin yang disatukan adalah berdasarkan 6 jam pertama atau
sebahagian daripadanya dan jika melebihi jangka masa itu , hanya
limbungan akan dicaj setiap jam atau sebahagian daripadany a.
Caj limbungan dikira dari  masa vesel ditambatkan di sisi dermaga
sehingga vesel meninggalkan dermaga  atau dari  masa vesel
berlabuh sehingga vesel meninggalkan tempat berlabuh.

(ii) Caj marin yang disatukan hendaklah terpakai bagi vesel yan g
memuatkan dan memunggah barang-barang di dermaga atau
tempat berlab uh bagi maksud mengambil minyak atau  bekalan
kapal, pembaikan, pertukaran anak kapal, pemindahan dari kapal ke
kapal atau apa-apa perkhidmatan lain yang dikehendaki.

(iii) Caj marin yang disatukan adalah berdasarkan setiap panggilan dan
LOA setiap vesel seperti yang berikut:

PORT AUTHORITIES ACT 1963

JOHORE PORT AUTHORITY (TANJUNG PELEPAS)
(SCALE OF RATES, DUES AND CHARGES) (AMENDMENT) BY-LAWS 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 16, 17 A and 29 of the
Port Authorities Act 1963 [ Act 488], the Johor Port Authority, with the approval of the
Minister, makes the following by-laws:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These by -laws may be cited as the Johore Port Authority
(Tanjung Pelepas) (Scale of Rates, Dues and Charges) (Amendment) By-Laws 2019.

(2) These By-Laws come into operation on 1 November 2019.

Amendment of by-law 1
2. The Johore Port Authority (Tanjung Pelepas) (Scale of Rates, Dues and Charges)
By-Laws 2000 [ P.U. (A) 467/2000 ], which are referred to as the "principal By -Laws" in
these By -Laws, are amended in paragraph 1(1) by substituting for  the word s
"Johore Port Authority (Tanjung Pelepas) " the word s "Johor Port Authority
(Tanjung Pelepas Port)".

Amendment of by-law 2
3. By-law 2 of the principal By-Laws is amended—

(a) in the definition of "dangerous goods", by substituting for the words
"Johore Port Authority (Tanjung Pelepas) By -Laws 2000" the words
"Johor Port Authority (Tanjung Pelepas Port) By-Laws 2000";

(b) in the definition of "dangerous cargoes", by substituting for the
words "Johore Port Authority (Tanjung Pelepas) By -Laws 2000
[P.U. (A) 465/2000 ]" the words "Johor Port Authority
(Tanjung Pelepas Port) By-Laws 2000";

(c) by inserting after the definition of "dangerous cargoes" the following
definition:

‘ "free zone area" means an area at the  Port declared under
subsection 3(1) of the Free Zones Act 1990 [ Act 438 ] to be a free
commercial zone or a free industrial zone;';

(d) in the definition of  "Authority", by deleting the words "(Tanjung Pelepas)";
and

(e) in the English text, in the definition of  "Port", by substituting for the words
"Port of Tanjung Pelepas" the words "Tanjung Pelepas Port".

anchored until it leaves the anchorage.

discharging goods at the wharf or anchorage for the purpose s of
taking bunker or ship's supplies, repairs, change of crew, ship to ship
transfer or any other services required.
